verdict.rationale: Manufact documents an official MCP server that exposes its platform, organizations, servers, deployments, logs, and observability as MCP tools, so agents in Cursor, Claude, or any other MCP client can connect to and manage it. The changelog also describes a guided authorization flow that returns users to their client with a starter prompt. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the Manufact MCP server, and detailed documentation of its tool inventory and auth requirements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: exposes the platform, organizations, servers, deployments, logs, and observability, as MCP tools, so you can manage everything from Cursor, Claude, or any other MCP client.
Authorizing the Manufact MCP server from Cursor, Claude, or another client now walks you through a tailored setup step before returning you to the client with a ready-made starter prompt.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.manufact.com/mcp
